title: Juicy British Chicken Casserole
description: A garlicky and pillowy British dish featuring pistachio paste, this casserole is kid-friendly and paleo-friendly, with a smoky flavor from the cold-smoked paprika.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the pistachio paste, cold-smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken breast to the bowl and toss to coat with the pistachio mixture.
Transfer the chicken to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the coconut milk and arrowroot powder.
Pour the coconut milk mixture over the chicken in the baking dish.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 35 minutes.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
